name: Vilazodone
metabolism: CYP3A4 is the main CYP pathway, with smaller CYP2C19/CYP2D6 contributions and additional non-CYP metabolism. Only small amounts are eliminated unchanged in urine or feces.
summary: Vilazodone is an oral serotonin-modulating medication used to treat major depressive disorder. It is thought to act both as a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor and as a 5-HT1A receptor agonist.
